input: Draft an outline for my professional keynote talk

gold.taskTitle: Draft Outline for Your Professional Keynote Talk
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured outline for a professional keynote talk the user will be delivering.

questions.title: What is the core topic or central message of your talk?
questions.description: Understand the specific subject matter and the single main idea the audience should walk away with.

questions.title: Who is the audience attending this keynote?
questions.description: Identify the audience's professional background, knowledge level, and what they care about.

questions.title: What is the event or venue where you are speaking?
questions.description: Understand the setting, such as an industry conference, company all-hands, or academic summit.

questions.title: How long is your allotted time slot for this talk?
questions.description: Know the total speaking time to calibrate the depth and number of sections in the outline.

questions.title: What is the specific date or deadline for this keynote?
questions.description: Determine when the talk is scheduled so the preparation timeline can be planned accordingly.

questions.title: What outcome or action do you want from the audience?
questions.description: Clarify the goal of the talk, such as inspiring change, teaching a skill, or driving a decision.

questions.title: Do you already have key points, data, or stories to include?
questions.description: Find out what raw material the user already has so the outline builds on existing content rather than starting from scratch.
